title: An Open-Label Extension Study to Evaluate the Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Once Daily Mexiletine PR in Patients with Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 and Type 2 who have completed the MEX-DM-302 Study (ATLAS Study)
official: An Open-Label Extension Study to Evaluate the Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Once Daily Mexiletine PR in Patients with Myotonic Dystrophy Type 1 and Type 2 who have completed the MEX-DM-302 Study.
summary: Main objective: To assess the continuous long-term safety and efficacy of mexiletine PR for the symptomatic treatment of myotonia in patients with myotonic dystrophy type 1 and type 2 who have completed MEX-DM-302 study.
